pricing.notes: Patient-facing AI + telehealth app. Primary care: $29/mo subscription for unlimited visits OR $35/visit. Mental health: $73/session. AI symptom checker matches you to providers. Providers are mostly primary care clinicians treating mental health, NOT psychiatrists. Good for mild anxiety/depression. Not for complex psychiatric needs.

seo.meta_description: K Health uses AI symptom checking plus human clinicians. Primary care $29/mo, mental health $73/session. Primary care providers, not psychiatrists.

faqs.q: Is K Health good for mental health treatment?
faqs.a: It's okay for mild anxiety or depression. K Health's providers are primarily trained in primary care, not psychiatry. They can prescribe common medications like SSRIs but aren't equipped for complex psychiatric conditions, bipolar disorder, or treatment-resistant cases.

faqs.q: How much does K Health cost for mental health?
faqs.a: $73 per mental health session. This is separate from their $29/mo primary care subscription. You can also pay $35 per individual primary care visit if you don't want a subscription.

faqs.q: How does K Health's AI work?
faqs.a: You answer questions about your symptoms, and the AI suggests possible conditions based on data from millions of anonymized health records. A 2024 Cedars-Sinai study found the AI aligned with doctors 68% of the time. You then connect with a human clinician for diagnosis and treatment.

faqs.q: Can K Health prescribe controlled substances?
faqs.a: Limited. K Health can prescribe some controlled substances in certain states, but their focus is on primary care. For stimulants (ADHD) or benzodiazepines (anxiety), you'll likely need a dedicated psychiatry service like Talkiatry or Done.
For some users through employer or health plan partnerships. Most individual users pay cash-pay rates. Insurance acceptance is limited compared to traditional providers.

faqs.q: How does K Health compare to Cerebral or Talkiatry?
faqs.a: K Health is a general primary care app that also treats mental health, while Cerebral and Talkiatry specialize in psychiatry. If you need a psychiatrist or have complex needs, choose a specialized service. K Health is better for people who want an all-in-one app for primary care plus mild mental health support.
